name: app/workspace-switcher
title: WorkspaceSwitcher
summary: The top of the sidebar: the product mark and name over the current workspace or organisation, opening a list of other workspaces and account links. With nothing to switch to it is a plain link home.

props.name: href
props.description: Where the mark goes (the app's home).

props.name: workspaces
props.type: { name: string; href: string; current?: boolean; note?: string }[]
props.description: Workspaces to switch between; `note` is a second line (plan, region).

props.name: links
props.description: A few account links under the workspaces.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name prefix of the switcher ("Switch organisation").

behaviour: With more than one workspace or any link, it is a <details> disclosure whose summary reads "<label>: <name>" and whose panel lists workspaces then links.
With one workspace and no links it renders as a plain link to `href`, with no chevrons: never a control that does nothing.
The current workspace is marked aria-current="true" and shows a check.

roles: group (<details>) with its <summary> as the button
keyboard: Enter or Space on the summary opens and closes the panel.
Tab moves through the workspace and account links.
focus: The summary and every menu link show the `--ring` focus ring.

theming.brandOverlay: The mark comes from the `mark` slot (BrandMark), so each brand shows its own logo. Everything else, including the panel, is identical across brands.

noJs.without: Everything: the component is server-rendered HTML with no script.

responsive: Fills the sidebar's width; names truncate.
In AppShell's collapsed rail only the mark shows.
contract:
contract
  slot is "workspace-switcher"
  summary "Switch workspace: Nyuchi Africa" min_height 56
  when default shows a "Mukoko"
  when single slot is "workspace-switcher"
  when single shows a "Nyuchi Africa"
end

checks.say: Single: a plain link home, no disclosure.
